items.html: And you already know that Moses merited Bina, and he is in this phase. However, the phases of Tevuna and Yashsut, when the posteriors of the upper AVI extend within them, became Yashsut in the phase of the posteriors of the names HaVaYaH and EHEYEH of the Yudin, in their squared form. For the square of HaVaYaH is 184 in gematria, and the square of EHEYEH is 544 in gematria, since their face is always the phase of straightness, and the phase of posteriors is the phase of computation and squaring. Hence, AVI, in the phase of their face, are HaVaYaH and EHEYEH of the Yudin, 233 in gematria. And the face of Yashsut is the two posteriors of the two names mentioned, since what is posterior above is the phase of face below.
